resources.string: Copy newer Steam saves to this device before launch. Conflicts ask which copy to keep. Requires Steam sign-in.
Send device saves to Steam when you return to the launcher. Force-closing the app does not trigger an upload.
Top-right overlay with FPS, CPU and GPU load, RAM, and battery level and drain.
Skip the studio logos and opening quote and go straight to the main menu.
Delete the ported game and every setting, then build it again. Your saves and your Steam sign-in are kept.

This deletes the ported game and puts every setting — here and in the game — back to its default. It is then built again from the files already on this device, which takes 20–30 minutes.

You will be asked where the game's files are again. They are not deleted, so pointing at the same folder is all it takes.

Your saves are not touched, the game is not downloaded again, and you stay signed in to Steam.
Show the inventory, map, tasks, journal and crest on a second screen, with touch. Only does anything on a device that has two screens, such as the Ayn Thor.

Copy saves from Steam to this device. Newer Steam saves may replace older device saves. Conflicts will ask which version to keep.
Copy saves from this device to Steam. Newer device saves may replace older Steam saves. Conflicts will ask which version to keep.

Lower resolution reduces GPU load; higher resolution gives sharper images. The screen shape is preserved and presets never exceed native resolution. Keep game setting uses the saved in-game choice.
Applies next launch. Normal gameplay unlocks and Steam confirmation stay active. Optional checks help recover missed unlocks; fewer checks can delay recovery.
Check after scenes, saves, and resume
Lower FPS can reduce heat and battery use; higher FPS looks smoother. An explicit limit stays active for this session. Keep game setting allows in-game adjustment. Actual FPS depends on the device.

Launches Silksong and checks achievement flags already recorded in your save data against Steam. Load your save so its state is available. Eligible missing unlocks are submitted for Steam confirmation; this does not unlock unearned achievements. Startup and scene-load recovery checks run for this session even if automatic repair is off. Your saved repair settings stay unchanged. Internet and Steam sign-in are required.
Automatic protection: local saves are backed up before Cloud downloads. The five newest ZIP backups are kept. Downloads stop if a backup fails.
No local backup yet. A backup is created when a Cloud download starts and local save files exist.
Backup export failed. The local backup is still available; choose another destination and retry.
Changes save automatically. Display and achievement options apply the next time the game starts.
Download: Steam → device. Upload: device → Steam.
Launch the game to check achievement flags already recorded in your saves. The next screen explains the check before you continue.
Master switch for optional recovery checks. Turning it off keeps normal Steam unlocks active and disables the options below, except popups.
Look for previously earned unlocks when the game starts.
Check again after loading a scene, saving, or returning to the game.
Run a background recovery check at the interval below. Off means no periodic timer.
Listen for an extra game award event. This helper can run confirmation checks even when periodic checks are off.
Show a notification inside the game after Steam accepts a new unlock. Off only hides the popup.
